Name: Readers Digest
Author: remybach
Description:
[b]Install[/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*][url=https://github.com/remybach/stardew-valley-readersdigest/releases]Download this mod[/url] and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single-player and multiplayer.
[*]No known mod conflicts.
[*]Works in all languages
[/list]
[b]Config[/b]
You have the following options available in [code]config.json[/code]:

[list]
[*][code]clairvoyance[/code] - (default: [code]false[/code]) Make your farmer have a premonition and learn the recipe overnight (displays a tooltip saying you've learned the recipe upon waking up).
[/list][list][*][code]enableCooking[/code] - (default: [code]true[/code]) Enables the cooking channel digest (Queen of Sauce).
[*][code]enableTips[/code] - (default: [code]true[/code]) Enables the tips channel digest (Livin' off the Land).
[/list]
[b]See also
[/b][list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3037]Forecaster Mod[/url]﻿[/b]
[*][url=https://github.com/remybach/stardew-valley-readersdigest]Source code[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/remybach/stardew-valley-readersdigest/releases]Release notes[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/remybach/stardew-valley-readersdigest/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+sort%3Aupdated-desc]Report Issues[/url]
[/list]
